high_level_description: This image captures a dramatic scene of multiple fireworks or rockets launching into the sky at night. The setting is dark, with the primary light source being the bright, glowing tips of the rockets or fireworks. These lights create a striking contrast against the black background of the night sky. The rockets or fireworks appear to be arranged in a diagonal line, suggesting they were launched from a single point or in a coordinated manner. Each rocket or firework emits a bright, white light that trails behind it as it ascends, leaving a visible trail of light in its wake.
